source: UK National Curriculum (England), Key Stage 1 — Year 1 Mathematics & English programmes of study

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Count and represent numbers to 100
skills.summary: Count to and across 100, forwards and backwards, and read and write numbers to 100 in numerals.
skills.source: UK NC Mathematics Year 1 — Number: number and place value

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Addition and subtraction within 20
skills.summary: Add and subtract one- and two-digit numbers to 20, including zero, and solve one-step problems.
skills.source: UK NC Mathematics Year 1 — Number: addition and subtraction

skills.subject: math
skills.label: Recognise a half and a quarter
skills.summary: Recognise, find and name a half and a quarter of an object, shape or quantity.
skills.source: UK NC Mathematics Year 1 — Number: fractions

skills.subject: ela
skills.label: Systematic phonics decoding
skills.summary: Apply phonic knowledge to decode words, responding speedily with the correct sound for graphemes.
skills.source: UK NC English Year 1 — Reading: word reading

skills.subject: ela
skills.label: Reading comprehension and discussion
skills.summary: Understand books read independently and aloud by predicting, recalling and discussing events.
skills.source: UK NC English Year 1 — Reading: comprehension
